parts.text: The bank steps are thick with packs this hour.
Iron is dear at the forge today.
Need a sharper axe before I go back to the trees.
Logs sell faster when the carpenters are hungry.
Keep the gold in the box. Never in the pack.
Ore dust in the boots again.
Fish are slow on the Britain river.
Who is buying hides this week?
The bulk orders are stacking. That is the work.
Moongate glow means I stayed out too late.
Britain is loud. Minoc is honest.
A vendor in the mall asked too much for cloth.
House sign said greatly worn. Not my plot.
The docks smell of tar and old fish.
Someone left a pack open by the banker.
I will fill this last order and then I am done.
Rain on the Yew road. Trees still need cutting.
The smith wants more ore than I can carry.
Escort to the mines pays if you live.
Trinsic walls look fine from this side.
Skara's ferry is late again.
Vesper's warehouses are full. Prices will drop.
I marked a rune for the grove. I should copy it.
The provisioner is out of picks. Typical.
Luna mall is a long gate from here.
I do not hunt reds. I haul wood.
The tavern is warmer than the forest.
Another day of honest dirt.
Who took my spot by the good oak?
Bank line is long. Thieves love that.
I should see Minoc before the year is out.
Plate is for fighters. I want a better saw.
The carpenter paid fair. I will go back.
Wet boots, dry gold. That is a good day.
Covetous road is not for a pack this heavy.
I heard the house on the corner is falling.
One more load, then the box, then ale.
Sand for glass. Nobody thanks you for sand.
A check spends quieter than a pile.
The west wood still has a few honest stands.
The grave stones lean. Something moved behind them.
A shield that drops is a crew that dies.
The quiver feels light. I feel it in the draw.
Fire reagents clump when the pack sweats.
The road to Despise smells of wet fur.
Town talk is louder than any dungeon.
Altar next. Bring a healer or do not come.
Felucca pays. Felucca also takes.
Dark path, short words, long bow.
Bones teach if you stand and swing.
I would rather read than wait on a slow crew.
This city still needs an edge it will not thank.
Count the living before the gold.
A scroll in the pack is worth a chest of coin.
The shrine can wait. The road cannot.
Peel them. Do not greet a pack.
I stop at the cave mouth. That is sense, not fear.
Range first. Speech later.
A crew that holds is worth a named blade.
Trammel bones, Felucca gold. Know the difference.
Who marked the rune for the altar?
Plate that fits is better than plate that shines.
Call it if you see reds on the mountain road.
I will not tell the harrower story twice.
Virtue is a title. Steel is a habit.
The lute stays until the pits start.
Treasure maps lie more than they pay.
I take the left if you take the door.
Solo day. No one to blame but the swing.
Books keep. Boasts do not.
If the shot is true I will not need to say so.
Split the take before anyone grows a story.
The gate road is work enough.
Hold or go home. There is no third thing.
A still shot is worth ten loud ones.
I do not walk into packs. I peel them.
Tithe first if you want the shrine to know you.
Named steel costs a season.
Body escort is coin. Body recovery is friendship.
Keep the reagents dry. The rest is noise.
The banker is busy. That is the hour I like.
Empty fingers. Full eyes.
Lines are for people who want to be seen.
Open packs feed the quiet.
Night is kinder than noon.
A check folds. A pile shouts.
Guards look at faces. I look at straps.
Someone will shout. It will not be me.
The fence pays in silence.
That window has been unlatched all week.
Crowds are a blessing if you keep moving.
Do not follow a stranger's gate.
Gold on the stones is never free.
Jhelom purses are fat and the owners are drunk.
A lock that yields is a lock that was proud.
I leave by a different gate than I came.
Gray names go first. I go after.
The cloak is for the pack, not the rain.
Count your coin at home.
A trapped chest teaches faster than a parent.
Britain after lamps is a different town.
Empty hands, full cloak.
The banker is busy. That is the hour.
Dye shows. That is why it sells.
I do not fight a pack.
A name spoken twice is a name I drop.
Roof first. Door second.
Nujel'm heat makes hands careless.
The steps remember blood. I remember exits.
If they shout, I am already gone.
A thin crowd is a bad crowd.
Gloves that snag are a confession.
The museum piece wants a quiet wall.
Vendors lie with numbers.
I watch who counts in the open.
Day bells are for other people.
A ship at night asks less than a gate.
Keep the lift small. Greed is loud.
Shadow by the banker is rent-free.
If the pack is locked, the day is honest. I leave.
Grass and a follower. That is a full day.
Soft now. They can hear hurry.
Men can keep their wars. I keep the beast.
A hungry follower is my failure.
The bond takes as long as it takes.
Towns that hate mounts can wait.
Sheep first. Dragons later.
The west fields still have room.
A named beast is not for sale.
Meat in the pouch, water in the skin.
Ostards want open ground.
The zoo will take the extra ones.
A llama carries. A man complains.
Yew woods for a wolf that will heel.
Stable rent is cheaper than a lost friend.
Do not shout. The young ones startle.
Hue talk belongs in the tavern, not the field.
I judge gait before I judge price.
A nightmare is a later problem.
Skara wind is good for training.
The saddle fits or we walk.
Reds on a taming road ruin a week.
I will not take a pup into Shame.
Commands stay soft.
The horse market lies with smiles.
Bonding hours are a watch, not a chat.
A pack llama earns its keep in ore.
Shade first, then water, then talk.
I name them. That is the rule.
Circus crowds make beasts stupid.
Veterinary work is quieter than glory.
A wild pack is a closed door.
Moongates startle cheap mounts.
The field at dusk is the true test.
I walk. They follow. That is the whole art.
A dry creek on a long walk is a bad plan.
Keep the follower between you and the road.
Hue is vanity. Gait is life.
I will stable before I drink.
The grass is honest. Town is not.
Anyone need iron ingots? I have a few hundred.
Mining skill just ticked up. Slow going past 80.
This cave is picked clean. Moving deeper.
Minoc mines are packed with miners tonight.
I swear the ore respawns slower on weekends.
Smelting at the Minoc forge. Anyone want to chat?
Selling boards cheap by the Vesper bank.
My pickaxe broke again. Third one today.
Tinker, make me some shovels and I will pay well.
Pack is full of ore and I can barely walk.
Should have brought a pack horse for this.
Lumberjacking is dull but the logs sell.
Cut logs, sell logs, buy a house. That is the plan.
The forest south of Yew is quiet today.
I keep hearing wolves out past the tree line.
Anyone else smell smoke from the Britain forge?
Smithing is at 92 now. Almost there.
Grandmaster smith by the end of the week, I hope.
Just made an exceptional katana. Not bad.
Who wants plate? I take orders at the bank.
Repairing armor for 50 gold a piece.
Making platemail all night for skill gain.
Kryss after kryss. Cheapest way to train.
Daggers are cheap to make and they sell to the smith.
Tailoring is so slow. Bolts of cloth everywhere.
I cut a hundred bolts into bandages last night.
Sewing leather armor until my fingers hurt.
Dyed a cloak black and now everyone wants one.
Buying cotton and flax at the farm near Britain.
Anyone need a spinning wheel? I found one in Yew.
Selling dyed robes. Any color you want.
Fishing off the Magincia docks. Nothing biting.
Caught another big fish. The bank is full of them.
Fishing pole snapped. Back to the provisioner.
Pulled up an old pair of boots. Lovely.
Sea serpent near the docks. Keep your boats in.
Fish steaks for sale. Fresh from the pan.
Cooking at the Britain inn. Come get some bread.
Baked two hundred loaves just for the skill.
Burned half the ribs. Cooking is humbling.
Cooking went up to 70. Now the pies start working.
Need flour. Who has a mill nearby?
Scribing recall scrolls. Five gold each.
Inscription is expensive to train. Blank scrolls add up.
Wrote a book about the Yew woods. Want a copy?
Selling spellbooks with all the low circles.
Alchemy is just grinding ginseng all day.
Heal potions, cure potions, red and orange. Ask me.
Mixing greater heals by the Moonglow bank.
Who is buying empty bottles? I have a pile.
Carpentry at 85. Tables and chairs everywhere.
My house is full of chairs from training carpentry.
Making barrels for the Vesper merchants.
Built a bookcase, then another, then another.
Bowyer here. Arrows and bolts, fair prices.
Fletching arrows while I wait for my friend.
Feathers are hard to come by this week.
Chickens near Britain give plenty of feathers.
Selling bows at the Yew bank. Come look.
Crossbows sell better than bows lately.
Tinkering is the most useful skill I have.
Made a sextant. No idea how to read it.
Lockpicks for sale. Do not ask what they are for.
Clock parts, gears, springs. Tinker life.
Ore prices dropped since the new miners showed up.
Iron at 8 gold per ingot is a robbery.
Minoc is the only honest town left.
The forge in Vesper is always crowded.
Trinsic smiths buy weapons for good coin.
Selling hides by the stack. Tanned and ready.
I skin deer all morning for leather.
Somebody keeps stealing my cut logs.
Log piles attract thieves like honey attracts bees.
Recall to the mine, dig, recall to the bank. Repeat.
My runebook is full of mining spots.
Marked a rune at a quiet cave near Cove.
Shh, do not tell anyone about my mining spot.
There is good ore in the mountains past Vesper.
The mine north of Minoc has earth elementals.
Earth elemental chased me out of the cave again.
Anyone seen my pack llama? It wandered off.
Pack horse holds more than I thought.
Dropped my ingots crossing the bridge. Almost.
Carrying too much. Can not move an inch.
Overweight again. Should bank more often.
Gold in the bank, ore in the pack. Normal day.
This hammer is worn thin. Time for a new one.
Blacksmith guild dues are due next week.
Smith hammer, tongs, anvil. The good life.
Made a halberd. Heavy but it sells.
Weapons at the Britain smith are overpriced.
The town smith gave me 20 gold for a kryss. Robbery.
The vendors pay less for weapons than it costs to make.
My vendor sold three suits of plate overnight.
Vendor sold out of ingots again. Good week.
Need to restock my vendor before bed.
Vendor upkeep eats half my profit.
House near Cove is perfect for a smith.
Want a small house near the Minoc mines someday.
Saving for a tower. Only 800k more to go.
House deeds are so expensive this season.
I would kill for a house near a forge.
Someone placed a house right on my mining spot.
The new keep blocks the whole road to Yew.
Woke up to find my logs gone from the house.
Locked down everything this time. Lesson learned.
Secure chest holds my tools now.
Cotton field near Moonglow is a nice place to think.
Farm work is peaceful. No monsters, no reds.
Carrots, turnips, and onions. Selling cheap.
Buying wool from anyone with sheep.
Sheared sheep all morning. Now the yarn.
Weaving on the loom takes forever.
Spun thread all night. Now I dream of thread.
The tailor shop in Britain is always busy.
Just got grandmaster tailoring. Finally.
Tailoring is done. Now I can make real clothes.
Fancy shirts sell well to the new players.
Newbies keep asking me for free robes.
Gave a newbie some leather armor. Felt good.
Help the new ones. We all started somewhere.
Remember when we all wore the starter robe?
Lumber from Yew is the best around.
Oak, pine, whatever. Wood is wood.
Chopping near Skara Brae. The ferry is slow.
Skara Brae ferry again. I need a boat.
Bought a small boat to fish the deep water.
Fishing in deep water is better. More serpents too.
Water elemental in the bay. Stay clear.
The Jhelom docks are good for fishing.
Serpent's Hold waters are full of fish.
Nujel'm fishers are always friendly.
The Buccaneer's Den folk pay well for fish.
Too many pirates around Buc's Den for my taste.
Ocllo is the quietest place to fish.
Magincia merchants pay better than Britain.
Magincia smells like money and roses.
The moongate in Moonglow is my shortcut.
Took the moongate to Trinsic by mistake.
Ice island has nice fishing. Cold though.
Wind is a pretty town if you can get in.
Reagent prices keep going up at the mage shop.
Mandrake root is getting hard to find.
Black pearl and blood moss, always in demand.
Picking ginseng in the swamp. Buggy work.
Nightshade grows near Yew. Watch the corpsers.
Corpsers in the swamp keep grabbing me.
Swamp work is not for me. Too many bog things.
Bandages are my best seller by far.
Scissors and cloth. Bandages for the fighters.
Fighters buy bandages by the thousand.
Made 500 bandages. Selling in stacks of 100.
Who wants custom dyed clothes? Name your color.
Dye tub is my most valued tool.
Found a rare color dye. Not telling where.
Blue robes sell twice as fast as red ones.
Hat collection is getting silly. Forty hats.
Miners should organize and set a fair price.
I refuse to sell ingots under 10 gold.
The market is flooded with cheap iron.
Everyone mines iron. Nobody buys it.
Good luck selling logs in Yew. Everyone cuts there.
Scribes keep the mages alive and nobody thanks us.
Recall scrolls are always the first to sell.
Gate scrolls cost more but sell fast.
Every mage wants a full book. Nobody wants to scribe.
Sat by the forge for three hours. Smithing at 97.
Almost GM. Please let this be the one.
GM smith! Finally. I can breathe.
Now I can make exceptional armor every time.
Just failed to make a bardiche. Lost the ingots.
Failed ten times in a row. Skill check hates me.
Wasted a whole stack of ingots on failed plate.
Smelting old armor back into ingots.
Melting down loot from the fighters.
Fighters drop their junk weapons on me to smelt.
Tailors should get paid more. Honest work.
Anyone want to trade logs for ore?
I trade in ore, not promises.
Carpenter for hire. Chests, tables, shelves.
Made a dresser for a friend's house.
House decorating is a craft of its own.
My house looks like a furniture store.
Crafting all day. No fights. Perfect.
Best part of the day is the quiet forge.
Rainy days are good crafting days.
Snow on the mountains past Minoc again.
The fog in Yew makes chopping a guessing thing.
It is dark already? I lost track of time.
Night falls and the mine gets creepy.
The torches in the mine flicker funny.
Heard something big moving deeper in the cave.
I think that was a troll in the tunnel.
Ettins do not care that I am just a miner.
Ran from an ogre with fifty ore in my pack.
Lost the ore to a lich in the cave. Classic.
I carry a dagger. That is my whole defense.
Recall scroll in hand at all times in the mines.
Reds at the Minoc mine again. Keep your eyes open.
Two reds just killed a miner by the smelter.
PKs love miners. We cannot fight back.
Someone should escort miners. I would pay.
Paid a warrior to guard me while I mine.
Guards do not come out to the mines. Sadly.
The town guards are the only friend a miner has.
Blacksmiths of Minoc, unite.
Our guild is all crafters. We keep to ourselves.
Guild hall has a forge now. Very handy.
Joined a crafting guild. They share tools.
Guildmate made me a runebook. Very kind.
My guild sells at the Britain vendor mall.
The mall at Britain is huge now.
Walked the whole vendor row. Nothing good.
Vendor search takes an hour on foot.
Found a vendor selling ingots at 5 gold. Bought all.
Resold the ingots at 9 gold. Easy profit.
Buy low, sell high. Even in Britannia.
Merchant life suits me.
I buy from shopkeepers and sell to folks. Simple.
Barter is dead. Everyone wants gold.
Checks are better than piles of gold.
Carrying 60k in a check. Feels risky.
Banked 10k from ore today. Good day.
The bank box is almost full of ore.
Need a second bank box. Or a house.
Selling colored cloth in any quantity.
Cloth prices went up since the event.
Heard the GMs held an event in Britain.
Missed the event. Stuck mining.
Crafters are the backbone of this land.
Warriors break it, I fix it.
Mages burn it, alchemists fix it.
If it is broken, bring it to me.
Every sword in Britain passed through a smith.
Sometimes I just sit at the forge and listen.
Quiet here. Just the hammer and the fire.
Anyone know where to buy a loom in Vesper?
The tinker in Minoc is out of tongs again.
Wts 1000 iron ingots. Make an offer.
Wtb spools of thread, lots of them.
Wts fine leather armor sets, GM made.
Wtb feathers by the thousand. Paying fair.
I will trade you a bow for some fish steaks.
My hands smell like fish for a week now.
Nothing like the smell of fresh cut pine.
The tree by the Yew abbey is my favorite.
Monks at the abbey buy wine. Who knew.
Brewing ale at home. Hope it turns out.
Honey from the Yew hives is the best in the land.
Beekeeping is harder than smithing, trust me.
My bees stung me twice today.
Anyone trade candles? Mine keep melting away.
Made forty lanterns for the Trinsic guard post.
Tinkering traps for a thief friend. Do not tell.
I make keys. Lost your house key? I can help.
Rekeying doors is a good side trade.
Crafted a globe for my study. Looks grand.
Maps of Britain for sale. Hand drawn.
Cartography is fun if you like drawing coasts.
Drew a map of the Lost Lands. Took all day.
The jungle near Papua is full of odd wood.
Delucia smiths buy good weapons.
Papua has the strangest merchants I have seen.
The Lost Lands are worth the trip for the ore.
Mining in the Lost Lands is risky but it pays.
Fished all afternoon off Papua. Two fish.
Took a pack horse through the Lost Lands. Brave horse.
Ophidians near the jungle. Mining somewhere else.
Terathans chased me off my best spot.
Giant spiders in the Minoc woods again.
Harpies near the mountain pass. Watch out.
Mongbats keep bothering me while I chop.
Rats in the Britain sewers ate my cheese.
Slimes ate my pickaxe. Seriously.
Headless ones in the Yew forest are no joke.
A bear walked right past me while I chopped.
The deer near Trinsic are fat this season.
Skinned forty rabbits for fur. Not proud of it.
Cows give leather too, you know.
Bulls near Vesper hit hard. Avoid them.
The shepherd near Skara Brae sells wool cheap.
Grinding cotton to thread. So much thread.
Dyed a whole bolt of cloth by accident. Purple now.
Everyone wears black lately. Black dye sells.
Selling fancy dresses. Real silk, well almost.
Made a jester suit for a friend. He loves it.
Bard robes on order. Bards pay in songs.
I sew and sing. The sewing pays better.
Sewing kits wear out so fast.
Buying scissors. Mine keep going missing.
New shop sign for my vendor. Looks sharp.
Named my vendor after my dog.
My vendor is more popular than I am.
People complain about prices, then buy anyway.
Undercut again by the guy two houses down.
Price war with the vendor across the street.
Selling below cost to beat the Magincia vendor.
Ingots at cost. Tell your friends.
Why does everyone want blank scrolls today?
Moonglow mages pay top gold for scrolls.
The library in Britain has good books to copy.
Copying the Book of Truth for the Moonglow shrine.
Books sell to the scholars in Moonglow.
I keep a diary. Today: mined. Tomorrow: mined.
Crafting logs: 300 boards cut, one splinter.
Carpenters, we should form a guild.
Anyone seen the carpenter guildmaster?
Guildmaster trained me up to 40 in carpentry.
Paid the smith trainer 300 gold. Worth it.
Training starts cheap but the high levels drag.
Skill locked at 90. Saving points for taming.
Swapping from fishing to mining. Fishing is dead.
Dropped tailoring to make room for alchemy.
Seven crafts at GM is my dream.
Legendary smith? Maybe in another life.
Stuck at 99.8 blacksmithy. It mocks me.
Lost a point of mining somehow. Forgot to lock.
Anyone want to watch me hammer? It is soothing.
Miners always have dirt under their nails.
I love the sound of ore hitting the pack.
Hit an empty vein. On to the next rock.
There is no metal here to mine. Again.
You dig and dig and find nothing.
Found a nice vein just past the entrance.
Mountain side near Jhelom has good spots.
Jhelom mines are full of fighters looking for duels.
The pits in Jhelom are louder than the forge.
Serpent's Hold smiths make fine shields.
Buccaneer's Den buys everything, no questions asked.
Selling in Buc's Den feels a bit shady.
Took a boat to Nujel'm to sell silk.
Nujel'm pays well for fine clothes.
Moonglow has the best alchemy shop.
Magincia bakers are the best cooks.
Cove is safe for new crafters.
Cove has the orcs just outside. Stay in town.
Vesper bridges are good for fishing too.
Minoc smithy has four anvils. Luxury.
Trinsic has the best sword trainers around.
Britain bank is too loud to think.
Skara Brae is quiet enough for scribing.
Yew is for woodcutters and monks.
Wind has the finest reagent shop.
Can not get into Wind without magic. Annoying.
Ocllo farmers sell cheap wheat.
Anyone going to Ocllo? I need a gate.
Can a mage gate me to Minoc? I will pay.
Paid 100 gold for a gate to Vesper. Worth it.
Walking to Minoc from Britain takes forever.
My legs hurt from walking the whole road.
Should learn magery just to recall.
Recall scrolls are cheaper than a mage friend.
Out of recall scrolls. Walking it is.
Rune to the Minoc forge got lost. Remarking.
Runebook charges are empty. Need scrolls.
Bought a bag of reagents for my alchemy.
Potion kegs are a smart way to store potions.
Made a keg of heal potions. Heavy as a horse.
Explosion potions for the fighters. Careful.
The last explosion potion went off in my hand.
Singed my eyebrows making purple potions.
Alchemy is dangerous work. Do not smoke nearby.
Poison potions for the hunters only. Not thieves.
Nightsight potions sell well to miners.
Agility potions are a hard sell.
Strength potions for the warriors, 20 gold each.
Refresh potions are cheap to make.
My mortar and pestle are older than me.
Glass bottles break too easy in the pack.
Sand for bottles. The beach near Trinsic.
Buying reagents in bulk. Trade me your regs.
Garlic smell never leaves my pack.
Spider silk sticks to everything.
Sulfurous ash stains my robe.
Ginseng tea keeps me awake at the forge.
The healer bought all my bandages today.
Made a fortune selling bandages at the pits.
Fighters in the Jhelom pits buy by the hundred.
Crafted a war hammer for the Trinsic guard.
Guards buy plate? Apparently not.
Should I learn arms lore? It helps repairs.
Arms lore tells me this sword is nearly broken.
Nearly broken gear everywhere. Repairs are brisk.
Repairs for free if you buy one new piece.
My guild owes me 5k for armor. Still waiting.
Customers who do not pay get no repairs.
The fighters tip well after a good hunt.
Warrior just paid me in dragon scales. Odd.
Traded a pickaxe for a map. Might be treasure.
Anyone want to help dig up a treasure map?
Digging for treasure is still digging.
My shovel is my best friend.
Rain makes the mine floor slick.
Thunder outside. The forge feels cozy.
Snowed on me the whole way from Minoc.
Hot sun in Nujel'm. Fish spoil fast.
Moon is bright tonight. Good fishing light.
Wind is up. Boats rock too much for fishing.
The fog lifts by noon in Yew.
Early morning is best for chopping. No crowds.
Midnight crafting is the best crafting.
Too tired to smith. One more batch though.
Going to hammer until the ore runs out.
This is my third load today. Legs are gone.
I dream of ore. Is that normal?
Some days the forge wins.
Hands are black from the coal.
Cloth dust makes me sneeze.
Sawdust in my hair again.
Fish scales stuck on my boots.
Ale after work is the whole point.
The tavern in Minoc serves the miners first.
The barmaid in Vesper knows my order.
Buying a round for the miners. Good day at the rock.
Heard the Minoc mines are haunted.
Old miners say there is gold deep in Covetous.
No way I am mining in a dungeon.
Some miners dig in Shame. Crazy folk.
Heard about a miner killed in Wrong last week.
The Deceit crowd buys bone armor. Weird customers.
Selling bone armor made from real bones. Creepy.
Bone crafting is not for the squeamish.
Studded leather is the best seller for newbies.
Ringmail is ugly but cheap to make.
Chainmail coifs in stock. Only a few.
Close helms sell faster than plate helms.
Everyone wants a plate helm with a visor.
Norse helms for the viking look. On order.
Kite shields in stock, heater shields sold out.
Buckler for the mage who likes to hit things.
Making a bardiche for the tall warrior guy.
Spears for the fencers, maces for the brutes.
War axes? Only on request. They weigh a ton.
My crafted weapons break less. Just saying.
Exceptional quality every time now. Smithing pays off.
Maker's mark on everything I craft.
My name on a sword. That is my legacy.
Found my own sword on a fighter at the bank.
A fighter swore by my plate today. Proud moment.
The PKs wear my armor too. Can not help it.
Sold armor to a red. Bad idea, maybe.
I sell to anyone with gold. Blues and reds alike.
Guards watch my shop now. Safer.
Crafters get robbed less if they bank often.
Thief tried my pack at the forge. Found only ore.
Nothing but ore and tongs in here. Good luck.
Keep the tools in the pack, the gold in the bank.
Smelters should have locks.
Heard a smith in Vesper got killed by a daemon.
Daemons in town? Must be a mage gone wrong.
Summoned creature walked into the forge. Chaos.
Mage summoned an earth elemental by the anvil.
Chickens wandered into the tailor shop again.
Dogs in Britain chase my pack horse.
My pack horse ate the carrots I was selling.
Llama spit on my new robe.
Good work today. Pack sold, bank fat.
Quiet profit is the best profit.
Tomorrow I will cut the old oaks by Yew.
Might take the week off from mining.
Lag spike right as the lich cast. Figures.
Hands shaking after that ogre fight.
Two ettins at once is one ettin too many.
Heal timer is killing me. Hold them off.
Took a flamestrike to the face. Still standing.
My horse died under me in the Yew woods.
Riding into Despise was a bad idea. Poor horse.
Walk softly past the dragon. Do not wake it.
Kill the mage first, then the fighters.
Crossbow bolts are almost gone. Heading back.
Sharpened my katana on the Trinsic grindstone.
Oiled my plate. Squeaks less in the halls.
Bandaged my own head. Healing is a gift.
Watching the stairs for anything coming up.
The Despise bridge is the best place to fight.
Orc Cave is a good place to warm up.
The Orc Cave near Yew has a nasty orc lord.
Terathan drones are weak. The matriarch is not.
Fire dungeon lava is no place for a slow walker.
Ice fiends in the Ice dungeon. Bring fire.
Wrong has the best silver serpents.
Destard is the dragon lair. Respect it.
Champion spawn in Despise tonight. Who is in?
Heading to the Ilshenar dungeons for a change.
Ilshenar has the best hunting spots now.
Trammel is too safe for a real fight.
Felucca at night is where the real fights are.
